adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members`, the diff changes pagination to always use `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and applies it directly in `group.users...limit(limit)`. There is no upper bound/clamp on `limit`, and this endpoint appears to be a regular (non-admin) GroupsController action, so a client can supply an extremely large `limit` to force large DB reads and large JSON serialization. Previously, limiting/offsetting was only applied for automatic groups with a relatively small default (200); now it is applied for all groups but still without a maximum, making the finding verifiable from the diff.
